title: உத்தியோகம் vs சொந்த தொழில் (Employment vs Own Business)
description: Lagna lord in hidden houses (3,6,8,12) while 6th lord is strong indicates salaried employment. 10th lord exalted or in own house leads to independent business entrepreneurship.

title: மத்திய அரசு வேலை யோகம் (Central Government Employment)
description: Mercury connected with Venus or Jupiter, along with Saturn aspecting Sun/Mars or placed in their constellations, grants Central Government job.

title: மாநில அரசு வேலை யோகம் (State Government Employment)
description: Mercury + Sun + Mars + Saturn mutual link (e.g. Mars aspecting Sun/Mercury from Saturn's house/star) grants State Government job.

title: தந்தை வழி தொழில் / குலத்தொழில் (Hereditary / Father's Profession)
description: 9th & 10th lords (Dharma-Karma) conjunct with Saturn aspect ensures following father's profession, trade, or government compassionate allotment.

title: அடிக்கடி உத்தியோக மாற்றம் (Frequent Job Changes)
description: If Dasa Lord's dispositor is weak or in 6/8 or 2/12 relationship with star lord, every Bhukti brings job transfers or career shifts.

title: வெளிநாட்டு வேலை மற்றும் குடியுரிமை (Foreign Job & Citizenship)
description: Lagna lord in 3rd = outside town; 6th = outside state; 8th = neighboring country; 12th = distant overseas country. Rahu link = Islamic countries; Ketu link = Western/Christian countries. Exaltation in 8/12 = permanent citizenship.

title: நிரந்தர தொழில் - 30 முதல் 40 வருடங்கள் ஒரே தொழில் (Long-term Stable Career)
description: Sun + Saturn strong connection linking 9th house (father) and 10th house (karma/profession) grants 30-40 years of continuous stable tenure in single career path.
